title: Migrants from Lipa block the Bihać–Sarajevo road amid unresolved shelter
location: Bihać–Sarajevo highway near the Lipa camp; exact segment unknown
organizer: Migrants from Lipa; formal organizer unknown
participants_original: Several hundred migrants, according to police information cited by RFE/RL, blocked the highway overnight 23–24 December. This is a qualitative estimate, not an exact bound; camp occupancy is not the blockade count.
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporary report’s “several hundred” police estimate supports more than 50 participants at this local roadblock; exact minimum and maximum are not reported.
inclusion_ambiguity: The roadblock followed withdrawal of camp services and unresolved shelter. The source documents a domestic state/canton accommodation dispute but does not quote a direct demand by the road blockers, so a government-directed protest target remains pending. Do not attribute the camp fire to participants.

event_date.summary: RFE/RL dates the overnight police-reported blockade to the night of 23–24 December.

participants_min.summary: Police estimate as cited by RFE/RL: several hundred migrants; no exact bounds.

policy_target.summary: State ministry and canton/city authorities disputed temporary shelter at Bira; no direct statement from roadblock participants is retained.

state_response.summary: Cantonal police spokesperson discusses general situation; specific actions against blockaders are unknown.

notes: Separate from the Bira resident watch and the Lipa camp fire; no campwide count assigned to roadblock.
open_questions: Did participants articulate a demand to BiH/Una-Sana/City authorities?
Exact highway segment and police actions?
